english: The median of the eight observations $9,11,13,14,27,31,37,x$, where $x$ is a real number, is $16$. Then the mean deviation about the mean of these eight observations is ______.
hindi: आठ प्रेक्षणों $9,11,13,14,27,31,37,x$, जहाँ $x$ एक वास्तविक संख्या है, की माध्यिका $16$ है। तब इन आठ प्रेक्षणों का माध्य के सापेक्ष माध्य विचलन ______ है।
solution: Median $=$ mean of the 4th and 5th values: $x\le13$ gives $13.5$, $x\ge27$ gives $20.5$; so $14\le x\le27$ and $\dfrac{14+x}{2}=16\Rightarrow x=18$
solution_full: With eight observations, the median is the mean of the 4th and 5th in ascending order.
If $x\le13$: 4th and 5th are $13,14$, median $13.5\ne16$. If $13\le x\le14$: 4th and 5th are $x,14$, median at most $14$. If $x\ge27$: 4th and 5th are $14,27$, median $20.5\ne16$.
So $14\le x\le27$, the 4th and 5th are $14$ and $x$, and $\dfrac{14+x}{2}=16$ gives $x=18$.
originality_note: New: the unknown observation is fixed by the median of an even-sized data set (casework on its position), and a different centre, the mean, is then used for the mean deviation (way 5: median fixes the data, mean deviation about the mean measured). Closest known: missing observation from a given mean. Different because: the given statistic is the median, so position casework is needed.

Checked that x = 18 is the only real solution. Changed: No change.
key_step: Locating x among the ordered data to use the median condition.
justification: Routine two-step chain with light casework. Comparable to 2025-P1-Q14 (L2), which also fixes an unknown from a median.

concept_use.Median of ungrouped data: The median of 8 values, the mean of the 4th and 5th, gives x = 18 after casework.
